IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFullscreenPanel_Tool: When enabled (default), the inventory panel fills half of the screen and cannot be moved or resized. Disable to restore the native movable and resizable panel. NOTE: if you disable it with a save already loaded, you must restart the game (reload the save) for the windows to become resizable again.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiContainerInv_To: When enabled (default), all open backpacks are rendered in the player inventory grid. Disable to render only the selected container (better performance).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiContainerLoot_T: When enabled (default), all loot containers on screen are rendered. Disable to render only the active container (better performance).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsCloseOnEsc_Tooltip: When enabled (default), pressing ESC closes the inventory, loot and PaperDoll panels instead of opening the main menu. Disable to restore the vanilla behavior (ESC always opens the main menu).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsUiScale_Tooltip: Scales the size of the inventory grids (cells, items, headers). 100 is the default (full size). Increase it on high-resolution (e.g. 4K) displays to make the interface bigger and easier to read. Applies to open panels immediately after clicking OK.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsGradientFast_Tooltip:
Draws the item footprint gradient with fewer color bands (6 instead of 12), halving the gradient draw calls per item per frame. The gradient looks chunkier but the render is faster.

Off (default): smooth 12-band gradient.

This is a per-machine visual setting; each player chooses their own.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsPaperDollLeft_Toolti: When enabled, the PaperDoll (equipment) panel is shown on the left side of the player inventory instead of the right. The inventory grid shifts to the right to make room.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsJoypadCursorMode_Too: How the virtual cursor moves with the gamepad D-pad/analog stick in the grids. 'Snap to items' (default) jumps directly from item to item (Tarkov style). 'Cell by cell' moves one grid cell at a time, including empty cells.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsJoypadAnalogSpeed_To: Speed at which the virtual cursor moves when using the analog stick (0 to 100, 50 is the default). The harder you push the stick, the faster the cursor moves. Does not affect the D-pad.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsPanelOpacity_Tooltip: Adjust the opacity of the inventory backgrounds.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsSolidFootprint_Toolt: Renders a solid color instead of a gradient, massively improving FPS.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierCtrl_Tooltip: What happens when you hold Ctrl and click an item.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierShift_Toolti: What happens when you hold Shift and click an item.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierAlt_Tooltip: What happens when you hold Alt and click an item.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierRightCtrl_To: Action performed when right clicking an item while holding Ctrl.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierRightShift_T: Action performed when right clicking an item while holding Shift.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsModifierRightAlt_Too: Action performed when right clicking an item while holding Alt.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsAutoSearch_Tooltip: Automatically initiates search when you view a container with unsearched items.
